So I bought the game on sale and I was excited to try it out only to find there's so much issue with trying to log in or connect your steam account to EA online services.

Also, are they serious with this log in BS?! You got to log in EVERYTIME you open the game. This means if you have 2FA the game will ask you for a 2FA Code EVERY SINGLE TIME you open the game. 

It's 2 bucks but I can't even play the darn game.

This is what Little Nightmares 3 should have been.

Dark, edgy, intensely atmospheric.

Only it's very short. My total playtime was 7 hours and that included DLC and troubleshooting.

The game is indeed very beautiful but somehow.... it just felt hollow.
The story is weird. I suppose it's open for interpretation, but it makes little sense to me.  Yes I got the idea in the end (i believe), but still "meh".
Most events feel quite random, or too convenient just for making a certain puzzle work,  to pretend it's not just about going forward. Yes honestly it became annoying having to just press forward for 50% of the time. 
Beautiful sliding landscapes, yes...
I wish they could have done so much more with this idea. Sorry!

I feel like there were two teams making this game.

One was diligently showing up every day to make a great open world shooter, that is very polished and enjoyable.

Another showed up last week, super hangover, banged out nonsense of a plot line, bolted it on in a worst possible way, and also cranked up enemy spawn to 11 for "engagement".
Resident Evil 4: Where suplexing zombies is a valid strategy. Trust me.

I accidentally went to harran prison with only 6 hours in the game thinking it was a normal side quest. Spent the next 3 hours hard slog through an area I was clearly undergeared for. All my resources were exhausted with repairs and arrow crafts. I spent the last 30 minutes on low hp because I was out of medkits. The killing blow on the last behemoth broke the very last weapon I had, it could not have been any better even if it were scripted.

10/10 experience I will never forget.

This is a great game. Each run is randomly generated and it only takes about 30 minutes to an hour to play through the game, win or lose. Then you start at the beginning. However, there are so many different items so it never feels like you played the same run twice. There are lots of different paths to take as well. So many unlockable items and endings... It's just an endlessly replayable game. 10/10

I'm not good at writing reviews but hear me out. This piece of art is the most beautiful thing I've ever experienced in my entire life. Please.. play it. Please!
Edit: Because steam asked me to.

At first, I liked the beginning of the story and even started to believe that it was a good game with a good plot. But somewhere in the middle, you start to realize where the plot is going, and it's just bad... Couldn't they have written something more interesting than yet another reimagining of Romeo and Juliet, only within one family? The open world is beautiful but empty, and you can't interact with it in any way. All in all, it's better than Mafia 3, but the plot is banal.

I never expected a 6-8 hour game that is worth 30 dollars to actually be worth it, but this game actually was.  I can't really find a thing in the game to whine about.  The atmosphere and aesthetic is both beautiful and disturbing at the same time.  The enemies are very unsettling and creepy combined with the music made me even more anxious than I already was.  The puzzles were pretty straight-forward and never felt annoying to do.  The story is compelling, keeping you engaged and you actually care about finding out all the mysteries in it. Overall, this game is one of the best horror games I've actually played and would definitely recommend giving it a try, just probably play with a controller if you have one because M/KB can be a little funky.
(Also you can hold hands with your friend which is literally the best thing ever and I hope future developers take notes)

A fantastic metroidvania which is carried a lot by its presentation. Wonderful art and fun writing help bring a lot of this world to life. The easiest comparison to it's gameplay would be Hollow Knight, but i feel this is a much more easy going experience than that game. It strikes a nice balance of difficult but not too much so with some QoL details that make the experience not too frustrating. If you're a fan of the genre this one is a really delightful experience!

To anyone on the fence, just get it. You will NOT be disappointed. Personally, I've never been into the roguelike games, as it gets too boring too quick. But Hades is truly special. Amazing voice acting, great animations, beautiful art style and music. I had a really good time with Hades and I can see myself coming back to it on my deck every now and then because new runs get quickly addicting.
